cells.raw_text: Vacuolar interface pattern with Colloid bodies in the spinous and basal layers and an upper dermal moderately dense perivascular infiltrate of lymphocytes.
granular deposition of C3c in the basement membrane zone
Vacuolar interface pattern with colloid bodies in the spinous and basal layers and an upper dermal perivascular mildly dense infiltrate of lymphocytes and increase in dermal mucin.
granular deposition of IgG, IgA and IgM in the basement membrane zone

Prominent interface dermatitis with focal vesicle formation and lichenoid infiltrate, prominent dyskeratotic keratinocytes with epidermal necrosis, follicular pllugging, superficial to mid-dermal perivascular, periadnexal lymphocytic infiltrate.
Focal vaculoar interface dermatitis with only a sparse perivascular lymphocytic infiltrate in the upper dermis.
linear deposits of C3, IgM, IgG along the basement membrane zone
Interface dermatitis with adnexal involvement and increased dermal mucin.
IgG, IgA, IgM cytoid bodies, linear fibrin deposits at the basement membrane, granular IgG and C3
Lichenoid dermatosis with staged apoptotic bodies in the epidermis. Peripheral inflammatory mononuclear infiltrate in the upper dermis. No mucin deposits in the dermis.
Positive for IgG: discontinuous low-intensity band and epidermal dermal junction. C3 positive: rough band

Dense infiltration of lymphocytes in the basement membrane zone, the superficial dermis and perivascular regions, absent melanocytes in the part of the basal cell layer, strong liquefaction degeneration and superficial dermal edema.

Interface reaction, with lymphocytes at the dermal-epidermal junction, occasional dyskeratotic keratinocytes, perivascular and perifollicular lymphocytic inflammation, rare eosinophils, sligh increase in mucin.

Hyperplastic epidermis with hyperkeratosis, diffuse spongiosis, lichenoid changes in the lower part of epidermis with lymphocytic infiltration, apoptotic cells and disruption of the dermo-epidermal junction.
thickening of the basement membrane with rough granular depositions of IgG and C3

SCLE: subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus, F: female, M: male, NR: not reported, NSCLC: non-small-cell lung carcinoma,SCLC: small-cell-lung carcinoma, OPSCC: oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma, HCQ: hydroxychloroquine.
